title: Bud Dupree was a healthy scratch after making comments about Chargers' front office

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bud Dupree was a healthy scratch after making comments about Chargers' front office
sources.description: One of the interesting, on the surface, storylines arising from Monday night's win by the Chargers over the Ravens came from the fact that L.A. linebacker Bud Dupree was a healthy scratch for the game — three days after he made some pointed comments about the team's front office.
